content.user_title: Draft Employment Contracts and HR Policies
content.value_statement: Employment documents need consistent terms and legal review checkpoints. This skill provides templates and checklists for offers, agreements, and HR policies.
actual_capabilities: Creates offer letter structures with role, compensation, benefits, contingencies, and acceptance sections.
Drafts employment agreement clauses for duties, compensation, confidentiality, IP assignment, termination, and acknowledgments.
Builds employee handbook policy sections for equal opportunity, harassment, attendance, PTO, holidays, conduct, and technology use.
Adds checklists for jurisdiction, employment type, clause selection, signature blocks, and counsel review.
Highlights when non-compete, at-will, benefits, and leave terms need local legal validation.
limitations: It does not provide jurisdiction-specific legal advice.
It cannot replace review by qualified employment counsel.
It does not verify current labor laws or agency guidance.
It requires user-supplied company, role, compensation, and policy details.

use_cases.title: Standardize New Hire Offers
use_cases.description: Create consistent offer letters that cover role details, pay, benefits, contingencies, and acceptance terms.

use_cases.title: Prepare Founder Hiring Documents
use_cases.description: Draft first-pass employment agreements with confidentiality, IP assignment, termination, and signature sections.

use_cases.title: Review Policy Draft Coverage
use_cases.description: Check handbook policy sections for common coverage gaps before legal or HR review.

prompt_templates.title: Draft an Offer Letter
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a standard hiring document.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an offer letter for [role] in [jurisdiction]. Include start date, compensation, benefits, contingencies, at-will language if applicable, and acceptance blocks.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Employment Agreement
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a structured agreement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an employment agreement for [employee type] in [jurisdiction]. Include duties, term, pay, confidentiality, IP assignment, termination, and signature sections.

prompt_templates.title: Build Handbook Policies
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for employee handbook content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a handbook policy section for [company]. Cover equal opportunity, harassment reporting, attendance, PTO, holidays, conduct, technology use, and acknowledgments.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Draft Document
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for gap analysis and revision support.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this draft employment document for missing clauses and unclear terms. Flag legal review items for [jurisdiction] and suggest concise revisions.

output_examples.input: Offer letter for a remote marketing manager with annual salary and benefits.
output: Offer letter outline with position details, compensation, benefits, contingencies, at-will language, and acceptance signature block.
Review notes for remote work, wage classification, and state-specific notices.

output_examples.input: Employment agreement for a full-time software engineer at a startup.
output: Agreement sections for employment duties, compensation, expenses, confidentiality, IP assignment, termination, and acknowledgments.
Counsel review flags for non-compete terms, equity references, and governing law.

output_examples.input: Handbook policy section for PTO, holidays, conduct, and technology use.
output: Policy draft with accrual placeholders, holiday list, code of conduct expectations, technology monitoring notice, and employee acknowledgment.
Checklist of details to confirm before distribution.

best_practices: Confirm jurisdiction, employment status, exemption status, and worker classification before drafting.
Use placeholders only for facts the user must verify before signature.
Have qualified counsel review final documents before use.
anti_patterns: Presenting templates as legal advice or final enforceable contracts.
Copying non-compete terms across jurisdictions without review.
Leaving compensation, benefits, leave, or termination terms vague.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides drafting templates and review prompts. Qualified counsel should review final employment documents.

faq.question: Can it create offer letters?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft offer letters with role, pay, benefits, contingencies, at-will language, and acceptance sections.

faq.question: Can it draft employee handbook policies?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes patterns for equal opportunity, harassment, attendance, PTO, holidays, conduct, technology, and acknowledgment sections.

faq.question: Does it handle jurisdiction-specific rules?
faq.answer: It prompts users to identify jurisdiction and review local requirements. It does not verify current local law.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide jurisdiction, company name, role, employment type, compensation, benefits, start date, and required clauses.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
